mapper.select: SELECT la.id, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, la.rent, la.payment_type_id, la.payment_status AS payment_status, la.status AS lease_status, la.source_type, ai.name AS apartment_name, ri.room_number, gi.name, gi.url FROM lease_agreement la LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON la.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN graph_info gi ON gi.item_type = 2 AND gi.item_id = ri.id AND gi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY la.create_time DESC

SELECT la.id, CONCAT(ai.name, ' ', ri.room_number, '房间租约') AS subject, ( CASE WHEN ( CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_order po_h WHERE po_h.is_deleted = 0 AND po_h.status = 1 AND po_h.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND po_h.term_start_date IS NOT NULL AND po_h.term_start_date != la.lease_start_date AND ( COALESCE(po_h.deposit_amount, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(po_h.amount_total, 0) > 0 ) ) THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST( COALESCE(la.deposit, 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(po.deposit_amount, 0)) FROM payment_order po WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status = 1 AND po.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND po.term_start_date = la.lease_start_date ), 0), 0 ) END ) > 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_order po_h WHERE po_h.is_deleted = 0 AND po_h.status = 1 AND po_h.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND po_h.term_start_date IS NOT NULL AND po_h.term_start_date != la.lease_start_date AND ( COALESCE(po_h.deposit_amount, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(po_h.amount_total, 0) > 0 ) ) THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST( COALESCE(la.deposit, 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(po.deposit_amount, 0)) FROM payment_order po WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status = 1 AND po.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND po.term_start_date = la.lease_start_date ), 0), 0 ) END ) ELSE GREATEST( COALESCE(la.rent, 0) * COALESCE(pt.pay_month_count, 1) - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(po.rent_amount, 0)) FROM payment_order po WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status = 1 AND po.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND po.term_start_date = la.lease_start_date ), 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(po.deposit_amount, 0)) FROM payment_order po WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status = 1 AND po.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND po.term_start_date = la.lease_start_date ), 0), 0 ) END ) AS amount_total, ai.name AS apartment_name, ri.room_number FROM lease_agreement la LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON la.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment_type pt ON la.payment_type_id = pt.id AND pt.is_deleted = 0 WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.phone = #{phone} AND la.payment_status = 0 AND la.status IN (1, 2, 7) ORDER BY la.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
